title: kithctl watch: last_message_state not updated on JMAP fetch error
description: In fetch_and_notify, last_message_state is only advanced when Ok(()). On a transient JMAP error (e.g. network blip), the cursor stays at the old position. The next SSE event re-fetches from the same since_state, which re-computes the same created-ID list. Because notifications fire per-notification without dedup, this means a transient error during delivery causes duplicate desktop notifications for the same batch of messages. Trigger: network error between SSE event arrival and JMAP changes fetch, followed by another SSE event. Bad behavior: user sees the same message notification twice. The fix is to either track notified IDs locally, or advance the cursor even on partial failure.
